zh: 超级管理员可以「进入」某个团队查看和排障：在「账号与权限」的团队标签上点「↪」，之后看到和修改的都是该团队的工具页面数据，页面底部会提示「正在查看团队」，一键返回自己的空间；被撤掉管理员后自动失效。
en: Super admins can enter a team to view or troubleshoot: click ↪ on a team chip in Accounts & permissions to work with that team's tool data, with a bottom bar showing the team and a one-click way back; it stops applying if the account loses admin rights.
